verdict.rationale: Persona is API-first and provides a sandbox with 'Simulate Actions' explicitly designed for programmatic/CI-style integration testing (persona-docs-9, persona-docs-3), implying headless automation is possible. However, there is no explicit CLI, SDK automation guide, or CI pipeline documentation describing headless operation for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: dedicated CI/headless automation guide, CLI or agent-facing tooling, explicit statement of non-interactive/headless operation modes.
